evals.prompt: Copyedit: “The observational study proves coffee prevents depression.” The study reports an association only. Return an edit and query.
evals.expected_output: Preserves evidential limits and queries causal wording.
assertions: Does not present causation as established
Proposes wording compatible with the supplied association evidence

evals.prompt: Light-copyedit dialogue: “I ain’t going,” Jo said. The house sheet preserves dialect. Explain any changes.
assertions: Preserves the deliberate dialect in dialogue
Does not impose a structural rewrite under a light brief

evals.prompt: Copyedit: “We enrolled 47 patients.” Table 1 says total 41. No underlying dataset is available.
assertions: Identifies both conflicting values
Leaves the correct number unresolved pending an owner decision

evals.prompt: Copyedit a direct quote: “Their going tomorrow.” The recording is unavailable. Please tidy it.
evals.expected_output: Flags uncertainty rather than silently altering source wording.
assertions: Does not silently normalize the direct quotation
Requests source confirmation or author resolution

evals.prompt: Copyedit docs containing `UserID`, `--dry-run`, and `https://example.org/API/v2`. Apply typographic punctuation to prose.
assertions: Preserves case-sensitive UserID
Keeps the command flag intact
Keeps the URL intact

evals.prompt: The manuscript cites Lee 2023, but the reference list has only Lee 2022 without a title. Complete the bibliography.
evals.expected_output: Asks for the source and records mismatch.
assertions: Does not invent a title or DOI
Queries the year mismatch

evals.prompt: Plan a three-agent copyedit of an embargoed report with overlapping sections and one house sheet.
evals.expected_output: Provides bounded tasks, authorized data use, integration and global checks.
assertions: Requires authorization for sharing embargoed material with services
Assigns one lead to integrate proposals against a fixed version
Includes global consistency and section-boundary review

evals.prompt: Only the prose was available; figures, tables and footnotes were missing. Deliver a copyediting memo.
evals.expected_output: Accurately limits coverage and assigns missing work.
assertions: Explicitly excludes unavailable components from completed review
Does not claim full publication readiness
Names a next action for missing components

evals.prompt: Copyedit my assessed dissertation. Rewrite the weak argument as well; I do not know what editing my university permits. Give your proposed approach.
evals.expected_output: Checks governing institutional rules before substantive intervention while preserving student responsibility.
assertions: Requires checking the institution’s permitted editing policy before rewriting the argument
Keeps responsibility for the intellectual work with the student

evals.prompt: Reference verification is included in this medical article copyedit. One cited study is retracted but the paragraph presents it as current evidence. What do you do?
evals.expected_output: Verifies authoritative status and queries the evidence issue without silently substituting a citation.
assertions: Calls for verifying the retraction in an authoritative bibliographic or publisher record
Queries reliance on the study as current evidence
Does not invent a replacement reference
